description: This file contains a test class 'VersionPlacementTests' that verifies grain placement behavior during version upgrades in an Orleans-based distributed system. It uses specific versioning and compatibility strategies, and includes a test method 'ActivateDominantVersion' that starts silos and checks grain versions.

classes.name: VersionPlacementTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies grain placement during version upgrades using specific versioning and compatibility strategies.

methods.name: ActivateDominantVersion
methods.description: An asynchronous test method that starts silos, retrieves grains, and asserts their versions to verify correct placement during upgrades.
